en: A vintage, sepia-toned postcard back with printed German word 'Postkarte' and horizontal address lines. It bears a circular postmark from München (Munich) dated 9.8.12 with German text around the rim. Handwritten text in ink, mostly in Spanish, fills the left side message area and the right side address area. The address is to a person in Santander, España. There is a rectangular area in the upper right for a stamp, now missing or faded. The card shows signs of age such as foxing and discoloration. At the bottom left is a modern label 'M.C.D.2020'.
